title: Active-Learning Surrogate Competition for Cell-Media Titer Optimisation — Reproducibility Package
description: Minimal code package accompanying the Bioinformatics paper Benchmarking active-learning surrogates for cell-media titer optimisation. Implements two competition protocols (Hide-the-Label and Open-Race) under two difficulty regimes (Regular and Hard) across six published cell-culture / cell-media datasets, with surrogate families spanning Gaussian processes, random forests, neural networks, and Bayesian neural networks. Bundled with the six input datasets. Post-processed JSON results and raw tournament logs are not bundled — they can be regenerated from the runner scripts in run_*.py.
